fusions.name: Run It to Ground
fusions.desc: You run down an enemy up to 6 tiles away and bite for 15 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Blood for the Pack
fusions.desc: Strikes an enemy up to 6 tiles away for 28 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. Your party deals 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Roost-Mate's Portion
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Duskhound
fusions.desc: A bonded dusk hound fights beside you, striking enemies within 4.5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Each kill restores 3 health to you.
